complete_shape_containment.producer_caveat: The full-run original producer summary retained 5300 invalid_body_position type rejections from NumPy scalars under strict validation. This replay uses unchanged serialized raw numeric pose values decoded as Python floats; it does not erase or relabel those original failures.
complete_shape_containment.registry_source: the same path/type registry reconstructed from authorized_colliders exactly as the original probe does
complete_shape_containment.scope: Offline replay only establishes exact measured full-primitive containment, not live static/dynamic collision safety, fresh leases, or future unsupported postures.

historical_metadata_caveat: world_builder.observed_standing_body_z_range_m [.478,.544] is a historical broad range including gait, not the measured source 10-20 s cold-standing range above.
interpretation: The measured .52 walking median does not establish .52 cold stance; separate actual stance and gait domains.

The official plant receives vx/wz and cannot directly execute a requested positive vz. A nominal initial Z mismatch may consume 3D curve timing while tiny XY demand cannot start real gait. Height calibration removes this artificial mismatch but is not a causal proof that the entire deadlock is fixed.

If gait-dependent Z still dominates the trajectory domain, evaluate a platform-specific model of controllable forward/yaw motion with measured full-Z support/volume bounds. Do not erase Z, fabricate velocity, bypass collision evidence, or impose a minimum high-level speed.
Cold position is stable while native raw world vz is around +.00744 m/s. Both measurements are retained as recorded; no derivative substitution or fabricated zero vz is used.

reference_calibration.limits: A cold stand reference is not an actual-body pose replacement. Walking and post-walk standing heights vary; this parameter-only hypothesis requires new original-framework navigation validation.
reference_calibration.reason: Match the ground-to-body reference to the measured stable cold stance and remove its artificial 39.255 mm startup rise. Increasing above by the nominal height reduction preserves the previous planned absolute upper 1.07 m; it does not shrink real collision solids.
